nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Shared cost-field writer (extracted from Execute LLM Call's Sum Task Cost + Update CU Cost Field so both lanes write the field via ONE path; unification per CLAUDE.md). Input: clickup_task_id. Returns {total} = SUM(agent_runs.cost_pln) for the task (the value just written to CU field ca7a3874). Fail-soft: a DB or CU error WARNs and still returns (total falls back to 0).

nodes.name: Sum Task Cost
nodes.notes: Authoritative task cost = SUM(agent_runs.cost_pln) over all rows for the task (gate + research + text + image rows that carry the task id). onError=continueErrorOutput so a transient DB miss routes to the WARN and the call still returns.

nodes.name: Update CU Cost Field
nodes.notes: Writes running total to CU '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]' (field ca7a3874). On success -> Build Return; on error -> Alert Cost Sync Failed (reconverges to Build Return), so a cost-sync failure never blocks the caller.

nodes.name: Alert Cost Sync Failed
nodes.notes: WARN (ADR-025 seam) when the SUM query or the CU field POST fails. Non-blocking: reconverges into Build Return so the caller still gets a (fallback 0) total.

value.message: Nie udało się zsynchronizować kosztu zadania do pola CU '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]'.

nodes.name: Build Return
nodes.notes: SOLE branch-free TERMINAL. Re-reads Sum Task Cost via absolute ref (so the incoming item — Update success or Alert — doesn't matter). Returns {total} = the written SUM (0 if the SUM errored). Caller uses it for the comment footer (managed lane).
